## Default Permission

Allow bounded binary window/panel ownership exchange.

#### This default permission set includes the following:

- `allow-exchange`

## Permission Table

<table>
<tr>
<th>Identifier</th>
<th>Description</th>
</tr>


<tr>
<td>

`tools-frontend-host-tauri:allow-exchange`

</td>
<td>

Enables the exchange command without any pre-configured scope.

</td>
</tr>

<tr>
<td>

`tools-frontend-host-tauri:deny-exchange`

</td>
<td>

Denies the exchange command without any pre-configured scope.

</td>
</tr>
</table>
